reviews.text:
Juliana - Top dog sitter! 🐾 Thank you so much! Very good and kind!
I felt very comfortable during the holidays because I knew my dog ​​was doing great!
✨Highly recommended! 🙌🏼 …
Our friend Baldo had a great time with Giuliana! Highly recommended! :)
The best dog sitter ever - attentive, flexible, and very responsive to our needs. We left our dog with her for a week and he came back very happy and rested 💜

When organizing a trip in the middle of summer with family, it's often a bit complicated to travel with our dogs, especially during the summer months. I find it very difficult to leave them in someone else's care, as my English bulldog is very particular because he suffers a lot in the heat and requires a lot of care due to his breed. But I met Juliana, and I didn't hesitate for a second to leave them with her. I left my two dogs with Juliana for nine days, and it was truly the best decision I could have made! She cared for them as if they were in my own home, keeping me informed at all times about my dogs and their care. Every day she sent me photos so I could see them and brighten my day. She gave me a lot of confidence, and we were able to enjoy our vacation with complete peace of mind. For me, my two dogs are the most important thing I have, and Juliana took care of them as if they were my own. Thank you, Juliana; my dogs have a second home in Naples :) Until the next vacation. I recommend her 100%, and we will be back.

I needed a full-day boarding house, but it's hard to find people who are not only RELIABLE but also have LOVE and passion for our four-legged friends. Juliana and Gianluca made my Elio feel at home like I've never felt outside of my own home. You can't find better! They provide care, fun, cuddles, and a few healthy treats. I'm so happy I found you. Thank you ❤️🐾
We spent a day in Naples and left our dog with Juliana, a wonderful person. She took him around and cuddled him all day, even sending us videos and photos. Highly recommended.

Separating yourself from your love is incredibly difficult. It was the first time I left my sweet Achille, and I felt like I was betraying him. Luck brought me to meet two exceptional people (to say the least), Juliana and Gianluca, who give your little one as much love as you do yourself. Love, care, dedication, attention, everything he needs. I will thank them endlessly for existing, because now I know that if I walk away, I have great hands and hearts to entrust my great love to. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. I recommend them not 100 times, but endlessly.

Our beloved dog was cared for with love and care for 10 days. She came home without showing any signs of stress, as she had with other dog sitters. Juliana is knowledgeable and loving, and she sent us photos and videos of our Luna every day. I highly recommend her.

Juliana is a top dog sitter! It was my first time leaving my dog ​​with someone, and I was very skeptical, but she immediately put me at ease.
Kind, helpful, and a true dog lover, she sent me lots of photos and videos, and my puppy had a wonderful time with her for three days. I absolutely recommend her! 🐾😊 …

Juliana and Gianluca are fantastic! 🐾 Deva immediately felt at home, super pampered and looked after with such care. It's wonderful to find such sweet, reliable, and helpful people. Highly recommended to anyone looking for someone to care for their four-legged friend with love and professionalism! 💛 …
Juliana is truly our puppies' best friend, reliable and professional, I really felt very comfortable...👍🏼 …

Juliana is a very sweet and affectionate girl with my dog! She and Gianluca give her so much attention, and my little furry friend always comes home happy! Thank you guys from the bottom of my heart ❤️

Juliana and Gianluca are two exceptional guys!! My goddess runs to them when she sees them, which means they're okay and I'm at peace! They're attentive to every need and pamper my dog ​​as much as possible! Thank you so much always!!

Juliana and her husband took excellent care of our Labrador. We spent the day exploring Pompeii, where only small dogs are allowed, and the heat and lack of shade would have been unbearable for any dog. Juliana was incredibly kind, flexible, and relaxed. Communication via WhatsApp was seamless, and she even gave us valuable tips for planning our day. We received lots of photos and videos throughout the day, so we could see that our Snoops was having a wonderful time. Two thumbs up! 👍🏼

My Chloe spent a week practically on vacation with Juliana, who was wonderful. She took her for beautiful walks in the parks every day, cuddled her at home, and even slept with her. I couldn't have asked for anything better. She and her husband are truly special people.
I'm happy to have met you and found a safe place to leave my little girl. She had a wonderful time; in fact, I was afraid she wouldn't want to come back to us.

Thank you for all the love you've given her and for all the photos you've sent me, so I can always feel at peace, because she couldn't have been in better hands. Best regards from Chloe ♥️, who will miss you so much. 😘😘

Juliana is the best dog sitter you could ask for. Charlie boarded with her for 10 days and had a wonderful time, with walks, trips to the park, and plenty of cuddles and photos every day without having to ask. I was confident it was a wonderful vacation for him too. I'm very anxious, in fact, I'd already brought Charlie a few times for a few days just to get to know him, but we immediately built trust with her. You can see the love, attention, and care she puts into her work. Both she and her husband are animal lovers. Wonderful people who are hard to find. To be absolutely sure, I couldn't entrust him to anyone else. Charlie felt right at home, even better. I recommend her to everyone. Thank you for the love and care you put into her.
See you soon from Charlie ❤️

Juliana and Gianluca are two professionals in the animal sector and, above all, animal lovers. Polite and very friendly, they keep you informed about everything your dog does, whether it's walking, playing, eating, or drinking. In short, they make you feel very, very at ease. They know exactly how to build trust with our four-legged friends. I find them excellent, both for day trips and for boarding.
I highly recommend them!
Wonderful people, super helpful and attentive to the needs of their dog. Juliana sent me photos every day and kept me updated. I owe her a lot.

Prosecco thanks you
Hi dear, I really wanted to thank you from the bottom of my heart for taking such great care of Prosecco this weekend. It's clear you've given it so much love and attention, and that makes me feel truly at ease. Your reliability and kindness are priceless. Thank you also for all the photos and videos you've forwarded me.

I think any word would be too small to describe my bulldog's stay at Juliana's house. I give it a 10 out of 10, and I was absolutely delighted.
She's incredibly sweet and attentive to every detail, and was always available to send photos and videos throughout our stay. A sincere thank you ❤️
Juliana and her husband Gianluca are a guarantee! They pampered our Frida like a queen, and we left with her in perfect hands! They're treating her like she was their own! Thank you for everything ❤️

Juliana is a true treasure. Her patience, her passion for our puppies, and the love she devotes to their needs make her truly unique.
Mia is a blind dachshund, but when I know she's with her, I feel at ease because in the constant photos she sends me, I see that she's happy and very pampered. ♥️

My Nina met Juliana when she was a 3-month-old puppy and they immediately became inseparable; she's her second mom. Juliana is a serious, reliable animal lover, and she constantly updates you with photos and messages. When Nina is with her, I feel calm and at peace because I know she's in good hands. She's having fun and feels at home 🏠. We're lucky to have met her 💕
